title: Describe: A wrong bill
prompt: Imagine a wrong bill. Identify a detail and ask for it to be checked. Describe the setting, the people and what you need to communicate. You can use a real familiar example instead.
steps: Choose a real or imagined setting.
Describe one scene without preparing full sentences.
Add one detail that helps a listener picture it.
Explain what you would want to say there.
Repeat with one selected tool or a different listener.
reflection: Did you remain with the scene?
What one difference would you explore?
